String1: Admin app to assist with the management of the website pepe.deals
String2: I developed this application to automate some functions of the pepe.deals website that were impossible for me to develop within the website.
String3: Below I explain the functions that the application has:
String7: Steam does not offer any tools to automate the process of adding new news to Steam groups, so develop a web browser that automates the process of adding news in multiple languages.
String9: Given the store's security measures and its lack of technical support, it was impossible for me to look at the store's deals on the website, so I had to create an 'ips jumper' to look at the deals.
String11: Amazon does not provide APIs or feeds to retrieve the games available in its Luna Standard and Premium plans. Consequently, I have to simulate opening a web browser, read the list of available games, and send that data to the pepe.deals database.
String13: Since Epic Games denied me access to their API for reading their deals, I had to come up with a workaround to retrieve them; I now have to load them in a semi-automated way in order to send the deals to pepe.deals.
